title: RefinementResponse
description: 200 response body of POST /api/refinements (HEL-411) — a PatchSet already proven valid via PatchSetPreviewService.preview (the SAME check POST /api/patch-sets/apply itself runs), grounded in the target's real current live state. The patch set is NOT applied by this call — applying stays the caller's explicit, separate action via the existing POST /api/patch-sets/apply (HEL-406).

conversationId.description: Identifies the persisted conversation this turn belongs to — pass it back as the next call's conversationId to continue refining the same target. Present on every successful response, including a fresh single-shot call (turn 1 mints a new conversation as a transparent side effect).
